resources.string: Your account and its data will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone, and nothing can be recovered.
Your account and everything the server holds for it, including your sign-ins on every device. Deletion is permanent: it cannot be undone and nothing can be recovered.
You can delete your account yourself, at any time, from inside the app. You do not need to write to us or fill in a form.
Nothing. No copy of your account or its data is kept after deletion, so there is no retention period. The server records only that a deletion happened, never whose account it was.
What is kept, and for how long
Open the web app to delete your account
Choose “%1$s”. It is next to “%2$s” on every signed-in screen.
Confirm. Your account is deleted as soon as the server confirms it, and every device that used it is signed out.
